title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 26, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.3 (Peaked November 26, 2026 at 15:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 307 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Thanks for stopping by! 🌎

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region is visible on the Sun’s right side, while no clear CME appears in the coronagraph view.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
